description: Dynamic attributes processing of what remains fails on the function blocks
notes: The README says the extension returns a body with the remaining content, which has no function blocks, so dynamic attributes processing should give its attributes. In the native syntax, hashicorp/hcl's Body.JustAttributes still reports the blocks that partial processing took (see native/structure/partial-remain-dynamic-attributes-after-blocks-taken), and the extension takes the function blocks with PartialContent (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go).
